-- Count releases for PageResponse. SELECT count(1) FROM announcement_source_classification_rule_releases release
release.release_status_code = #{releaseStatusCode}

-- Select one release and its rule counts. SELECT
FROM announcement_source_classification_rule_releases release WHERE release.id = #{releaseId}

-- Serialize mutations to one release before checking its row version. SELECT
FROM announcement_source_classification_rule_releases release WHERE release.id = #{releaseId} FOR UPDATE OF release

-- Serialize ACTIVE cloning and publication against the one ACTIVE release. SELECT
FROM announcement_source_classification_rule_releases release WHERE release.release_status_code = 'ACTIVE' FOR UPDATE OF release
-- Allocate a public release version while the ACTIVE release row is locked. SELECT coalesce(max(release.version_no), 0) + 1 FROM announcement_source_classification_rule_releases release
mapper.insert: -- Clone fixed policy values into a non-active DRAFT release. INSERT INTO announcement_source_classification_rule_releases ( id, release_code, version_no, row_version, release_status_code, rule_snapshot_hash, combination_operator_code, body_unavailable_action_code, attachment_analysis_enabled, auto_activation_enabled, change_note, created_by, created_at ) SELECT #{releaseId}, #{releaseCode}, #{versionNo}, 0, 'DRAFT', NULL, source_release.combination_operator_code, source_release.body_unavailable_action_code, FALSE, FALSE, #{changeReason}, #{actorUserId}, now() FROM announcement_source_classification_rule_releases source_release WHERE source_release.id = #{sourceReleaseId} AND source_release.release_status_code = 'ACTIVE'

-- Clone group policy while generating release-local group identifiers. INSERT INTO announcement_source_classification_rule_groups ( id, release_id, group_code, group_name, group_kind_code, target_category_id, support_type_id, title_action_code, body_action_code, sort_order, is_enabled, created_at, updated_at ) SELECT md5(CAST(#{releaseId} AS text) || ':group:' || source_group.id::text)::uuid, #{releaseId}, source_group.group_code, source_group.group_name, source_group.group_kind_code, source_group.target_category_id, source_group.support_type_id, source_group.title_action_code, source_group.body_action_code, source_group.sort_order, source_group.is_enabled, now(), now() FROM announcement_source_classification_rule_groups source_group WHERE source_group.release_id = #{sourceReleaseId} ORDER BY source_group.sort_order, source_group.group_code

-- Clone rules with row_version reset for the new DRAFT. INSERT INTO announcement_source_classification_keyword_rules ( id, group_id, rule_code, strength_code, is_enabled, sort_order, row_version, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at ) SELECT md5(CAST(#{releaseId} AS text) || ':rule:' || source_rule.id::text)::uuid, md5(CAST(#{releaseId} AS text) || ':group:' || source_group.id::text)::uuid, source_rule.rule_code, source_rule.strength_code, source_rule.is_enabled, source_rule.sort_order, 0, #{actorUserId}, now(), #{actorUserId}, now() FROM announcement_source_classification_keyword_rules source_rule INNER JOIN announcement_source_classification_rule_groups source_group ON source_group.id = source_rule.group_id WHERE source_group.release_id = #{sourceReleaseId} ORDER BY source_group.sort_order, source_rule.sort_order, source_rule.rule_code

-- Clone canonical and synonym terms without changing their enabled state. INSERT INTO announcement_source_classification_keyword_terms ( id, keyword_rule_id, group_id, term_type_code, term_text, normalized_term_text, match_mode_code, is_discovery_term, discovery_order, is_classification_term, is_enabled, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at ) SELECT md5(CAST(#{releaseId} AS text) || ':term:' || source_term.id::text)::uuid, md5(CAST(#{releaseId} AS text) || ':rule:' || source_rule.id::text)::uuid, md5(CAST(#{releaseId} AS text) || ':group:' || source_group.id::text)::uuid, source_term.term_type_code, source_term.term_text, source_term.normalized_term_text, source_term.match_mode_code, source_term.is_discovery_term, source_term.discovery_order, source_term.is_classification_term, source_term.is_enabled, #{actorUserId}, now(), #{actorUserId}, now() FROM announcement_source_classification_keyword_terms source_term INNER JOIN announcement_source_classification_keyword_rules source_rule ON source_rule.id = source_term.keyword_rule_id INNER JOIN announcement_source_classification_rule_groups source_group ON source_group.id = source_rule.group_id AND source_group.id = source_term.group_id WHERE source_group.release_id = #{sourceReleaseId} ORDER BY source_group.sort_order, source_rule.sort_order, source_term.term_type_code, source_term.id
mapper.select:
-- Select one keyword rule with canonical term and synonyms. SELECT
FROM announcement_source_classification_keyword_rules rule INNER JOIN announcement_source_classification_rule_groups rule_group ON rule_group.id = rule.group_id INNER JOIN announcement_source_classification_rule_releases release ON release.id = rule_group.release_id INNER JOIN announcement_source_classification_keyword_terms canonical ON canonical.keyword_rule_id = rule.id AND canonical.group_id = rule_group.id AND canonical.term_type_code = 'CANONICAL' LEFT JOIN announcement_target_categories target_category ON target_category.id = rule_group.target_category_id LEFT JOIN announcement_support_types support_type ON support_type.id = rule_group.support_type_id WHERE release.id = #{releaseId} AND rule.id = #{ruleId}

-- Lock one DRAFT rule after the release row has been locked. SELECT
FROM announcement_source_classification_keyword_rules rule INNER JOIN announcement_source_classification_rule_groups rule_group ON rule_group.id = rule.group_id INNER JOIN announcement_source_classification_rule_releases release ON release.id = rule_group.release_id INNER JOIN announcement_source_classification_keyword_terms canonical ON canonical.keyword_rule_id = rule.id AND canonical.group_id = rule_group.id AND canonical.term_type_code = 'CANONICAL' LEFT JOIN announcement_target_categories target_category ON target_category.id = rule_group.target_category_id LEFT JOIN announcement_support_types support_type ON support_type.id = rule_group.support_type_id WHERE release.id = #{releaseId} AND rule.id = #{ruleId} FOR UPDATE OF rule

-- Resolve a group only inside the requested release. SELECT rule_group.id AS group_id, release.id AS release_id, release.release_status_code, rule_group.group_code, rule_group.group_name, rule_group.group_kind_code, target_category.category_code AS target_category_code, support_type.support_type_code, rule_group.is_enabled AS group_enabled FROM announcement_source_classification_rule_groups rule_group INNER JOIN announcement_source_classification_rule_releases release ON release.id = rule_group.release_id LEFT JOIN announcement_target_categories target_category ON target_category.id = rule_group.target_category_id LEFT JOIN announcement_support_types support_type ON support_type.id = rule_group.support_type_id WHERE release.id = #{releaseId} AND rule_group.group_code = #{groupCode}

-- Load a canonical order for hashing, preview, Golden QA, and publication comparison. SELECT release.id AS release_id, release.release_code, release.release_status_code, release.version_no AS release_version_no, release.row_version AS release_row_version, rule_group.id AS group_id, rule_group.group_code, rule_group.group_kind_code, rule_group.title_action_code, rule_group.body_action_code, rule_group.sort_order AS group_sort_order, rule_group.is_enabled AS group_enabled, target_category.category_code AS target_category_code, support_type.support_type_code, rule.id AS rule_id, rule.rule_code, rule.strength_code, rule.sort_order AS rule_sort_order, rule.row_version AS rule_row_version, rule.is_enabled AS rule_enabled, term.id AS term_id, term.term_type_code, term.term_text, term.normalized_term_text, term.match_mode_code, term.is_discovery_term, term.discovery_order, term.is_classification_term, term.is_enabled AS term_enabled FROM announcement_source_classification_rule_releases release INNER JOIN announcement_source_classification_rule_groups rule_group ON rule_group.release_id = release.id INNER JOIN announcement_source_classification_keyword_rules rule ON rule.group_id = rule_group.id INNER JOIN announcement_source_classification_keyword_terms term ON term.keyword_rule_id = rule.id AND term.group_id = rule_group.id LEFT JOIN announcement_target_categories target_category ON target_category.id = rule_group.target_category_id LEFT JOIN announcement_support_types support_type ON support_type.id = rule_group.support_type_id WHERE release.id = #{releaseId} ORDER BY rule_group.sort_order, rule_group.group_code, rule.sort_order, rule.rule_code, term.term_type_code, term.normalized_term_text, term.id
mapper.insert: -- Insert one rule into a locked DRAFT release group. INSERT INTO announcement_source_classification_keyword_rules ( id, group_id, rule_code, strength_code, is_enabled, sort_order, row_version, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{ruleId}, #{groupId}, #{ruleCode}, #{strengthCode}, TRUE, #{sortOrder}, 0, #{actorUserId}, now(), #{actorUserId}, now() )

-- Insert one canonical term or explicit synonym without regular expressions. INSERT INTO announcement_source_classification_keyword_terms ( id, keyword_rule_id, group_id, term_type_code, term_text, normalized_term_text, match_mode_code, is_discovery_term, discovery_order, is_classification_term, is_enabled, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{termId}, #{ruleId}, #{groupId}, #{termTypeCode}, #{termText}, #{normalizedTermText}, #{matchModeCode}, #{discoveryTerm}, #{discoveryOrder}, #{classificationTerm}, TRUE, #{actorUserId}, now(), #{actorUserId}, now() )
mapper.update: -- Update a DRAFT rule only when the client row version is current. UPDATE announcement_source_classification_keyword_rules SET group_id = #{groupId}, strength_code = #{strengthCode}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, row_version = row_version + 1, updated_by = #{actorUserId}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{ruleId} AND row_version = #{expectedVersion}

-- Disable or re-enable a DRAFT rule without deleting its history. UPDATE announcement_source_classification_keyword_rules SET is_enabled = #{enabled}, row_version = row_version + 1, updated_by = #{actorUserId}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{ruleId} AND row_version = #{expectedVersion}

-- Retire the previous ACTIVE before publishing the candidate in the same transaction. UPDATE announcement_source_classification_rule_releases SET release_status_code = 'RETIRED', row_version = row_version + 1, change_note = #{changeReason}, retired_at = now() WHERE release_status_code = 'ACTIVE' AND id <> #{excludedReleaseId}

-- Publish exactly the Golden-validated DRAFT version. UPDATE announcement_source_classification_rule_releases SET release_status_code = 'ACTIVE', row_version = row_version + 1, rule_snapshot_hash = #{ruleSnapshotHash}, change_note = #{changeReason}, activated_by = #{actorUserId}, activated_at = now() WHERE id = #{releaseId} AND release_status_code = 'DRAFT' AND row_version = #{expectedVersion}
mapper.insert: -- Record release and keyword mutations without source content or secrets. INSERT INTO audit_logs ( actor_user_id, action_code, resource_type, resource_id, result_code, metadata_json ) VALUES ( #{actorUserId}, #{actionCode}, #{resourceType}, #{resourceId}, #{resultCode}, CAST(#{metadataJson} AS jsonb) )
